description: This file contains utility functions for building context objects, handling errors, and managing run configurations in an auto-reply agent system, including threading context creation, error formatting, and run parameter assembly.

methods.name: buildThreadingToolContext
methods.description: Builds a provider-specific threading context for tool auto-injection based on session context, configuration, and provider plugin.

methods.name: isBunFetchSocketError
methods.description: Checks if a message string indicates a socket connection error.

methods.name: formatBunFetchSocketError
methods.description: Formats a socket connection error message into a user-friendly string with context.

methods.name: resolveEnforceFinalTag
methods.description: Determines if the final tag should be enforced based on run settings and provider.

methods.name: resolveModelFallbackOptions
methods.description: Generates fallback options for a run based on its configuration.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedRunBaseParams
methods.description: Constructs base parameters for an embedded run, including session info and configuration.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedContextFromTemplate
methods.description: Builds an embedded context object from session and run data, including threading context.

methods.name: buildTemplateSenderContext
methods.description: Creates sender context information from session context.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedRunContexts
methods.description: Builds combined embedded context, sender context, and auth profile for a run.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedRunExecutionParams
methods.description: Assembles all parameters needed to execute an embedded run, including context and base parameters.
